review.purpose: Second step of end-to-end smoke: synthesize speaker-aware German dialogue from the approved GPU smoke output
review.reason: Use detected speaker assignments and Supertonic feminine/masculine presets to produce a German smoke dub
review.input: GPU smoke JSON, first 15 seconds preflight and first 60 seconds workload
review.outputs: modal_control/batch_inputs/cpu_v2_preflight.wav and cpu_v2_smoke.wav and matching timing reports
review.quality_tradeoffs: Requires regenerated source-linked utterances and resolved speaker voices; retain native speech, conservative edge padding removal, whole-turn scheduling at 1.0–1.15x. Infeasible turns save native attempts and revision diagnostics, then fail without packaging. No automatic text revision or model retry.
review.cost_estimate: Actual cost unknown; 4 CPU and 16 GiB memory for two bounded 1800-second stages; billed CPU, memory, startup, storage and egress can apply
